text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and mild proteinuria are also noted. Glucosuria is present without ketonuria, which may warrant further evaluation for glycemic control. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
